name: openbb_economy_available_indicators
description:
Catalog of economic indicator codes and countries a provider offers, through the OpenBB Platform (obb.economy.available_indicators).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts econdb or imf; schema default fred (also rejected), but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it); imf needs no key.
Fetch a series with openbb_economic_indicators using a code from this list. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"provider": "imf"}
